title: Leading Mergers and Acquisitions/ Private Equity Partner Joins Jenner & Block's Chicago Office
主要内容: Mark A. Harris, a highly regarded M&A attorney, has joined Jenner & Block LLP as a partner in the Chicago office. He will lead the firm's Private Equity Practice and advise clients on acquisitions, divestitures, spin-offs, LBOs, going-private transactions, reorganizations, proxy contests, and other complex transactions. Harris has extensive experience in major transactions, including Wrapports, LLC's acquisition of the Chicago Sun-Times, Merge Healthcare's acquisitions, and various private equity deals. He has been recognized by Chambers USA and Legal 500 for his expertise in mergers and acquisitions and private equity. His hiring enhances Jenner & Block's transactional capabilities and strengthens its private equity practice.
